answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. A farm faces £61 in fees and a 10-day delay before the stamp dries for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The desk only stamps a name that carries Peregrinebound merlin hawk auditor osprey licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence merlin hawk auditors carry after falconry office audits. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Every oasis is counted once. One tundra, one entry. The tally keeps crystal.
